candidates.snippet: War has ravaged this economy. During more than 14 years of open conflict between government forces and Syrian rebels, farmers watched helplessly as water and irrigation networks were targeted, and trade links cut off

For many families across Daraa, southwestern Syria, agriculture is a livelihood passed down through generations. It forms the backbone of the local economy, in a region known for its rich production of tomatoes, olives, pomegranates and grapes, among other produce
